name: Atlantis Ironworks
summary: Iron and steel for Martian machinery. Hematite pellets are reduced with hydrogen in a shaft furnace at 900 degC, without coal or coke, and the sponge iron is melted to steel in an electric arc furnace.
since_note: About 2150: the Amazonis circle formed in the 2150s.
story: Atlantis City grew on rich iron ore at a low latitude into the energy and mining town of Amazonis. Many machinery makers built their factories there, though living conditions stayed rough.
process: Pellet feed of about 20 t/h of hematite
Hydrogen direct reduction in a shaft furnace (as in HYBRIT), Fe2O3 + 3 H2 -> 2 Fe + 3 H2O
Metallization measured by the lab every 4 hours, reported an hour later
Electric arc furnace, about 0.6 MWh per tonne of steel

sources.label: HYBRIT: fossil-free steel by hydrogen direct reduction
Vogl, Åhman and Nilsson 2018, Assessment of hydrogen direct reduction for fossil-free steelmaking, J. Cleaner Production 203
Hematite on Mars (Christensen et al. 2001, JGR Planets)
